changelog: - **The desalination example refills its chemicals.** Each chemical tank now holds at most what it starts with and gets a delivery every 14 days, from a delivery node beside it that reads its own table; a delivery brings 14 days of the tank's dose and only what fits goes in. The Template is now checked over 90 days of the same day's demand, with every stage running at every step; its note says so, and that seasons, changing seawater and maintenance are not in it. Frame 4 is taller, and the Timeline has six more strips, one per delivery.
